features.rationale: Extrude the longitudinal body profile across the width, including both low end lands and the ramps to the central plateau.
features.justification: Both ramp angles D011 and D012 are printed as 60 degrees to vertical. The coefficient 1.7320508075688772 is tan(60 degrees), evaluated to floating-point precision; multiplying by D013 gives the horizontal ramp run. The .88 height spans plateau to tongue bottom, and the underside shoulders are .125 above that bottom.

features.rationale: Add the continuous bottom tongue between the two underside shoulders.
features.justification: The front view shows the tongue extending uninterrupted for the full part length. Locate its left flank by subtracting the right shoulder width and tongue width from the overall width.

features.rationale: Make the first counterbored hole from the left low end land, with its small bore extending past the tongue bottom.
features.justification: End-view hidden lines show the small bore passing through the tongue bottom. D014 exceeds the local end-land height, so the bore depth safely overshoots the bottom. Counterbore depth is measured from the local low end land.

features.rationale: Repeat the complete counterbored hole at the specified center spacing on the opposite end land.
What nominal radius should be used at the two tongue roots? Only a maximum is specified.

notes: Material: 1020 STEEL. Units: inches. Model dimensions are nominal.
View break lines do not interrupt the body or tongue; both extend the full 4.25-inch length.
CFS and K are legacy surface annotations without supplied numerical finish definitions. Obtain the applicable company convention before manufacturing.
The mark beneath .88 has no supplied definition; the readable overall-height value is retained.
The unresolved root-radius feature does not authorize applying .015 as a nominal radius; select an actual compliant radius before finalizing the manufacturing model.
General tolerances: three-place dimensions ±.010, two-place dimensions ±.020, angular dimensions ±1 degree. The 3.750 hole spacing has an explicit ±.005 tolerance.
